affected_observations.raw_text:
我們持續推進北京－武漢雙研究中心戰略。戰略性地理分佈將有助於我們在人才引進和保留方面取得進一步
的成功。透過校園招募、社會招募及星雲訓練營項目，我們正快速壯大人才隊伍。截至2024年底，金山雲武
漢研發中心員工總數（包括實習生和外包員工）已超過620人。展望未來，武漢研究中心對我們培育更壯大的
人才隊伍、提升技術創新能力至關重要。

報告期內，我們的研發費用為人民幣420.5百萬元（58.7百萬美元），而截至二零二五年六月三十日，我們的
研發人員達1,094人。

展望下半年，我們將維持高質量發展和可持續發展戰略，不斷投資技術研發，並全面提升AI能力。同時，我
們將積極擁抱AI時代小米和金山生態系統的雲需求。我們旨在持續為客戶、股東、員工和社會創造價值。

root_causes.cause: Operating metric subject vocabulary has no R&D/workforce/resource allocation relation; known quantity/person units never receive a valid subject.
root_causes.owner: source semantic resource observer + production 0.9 projection

root_causes.cause: Plan action/object grammar excludes research allocation and specific technology capability actions; punctuation splitting loses bounded shared actor/modality across coordinated predicates.
root_causes.owner: source disclosure/state owner, using existing predicate_scope/observe_metric_predicate

root_causes.cause: Value precedes coverage by intentional anti-boilerplate invariant; description titles cannot win. Mapping all new information to one generic quantity topic still allows starvation.
root_causes.owner: source-proven, bounded reading_topics projection; existing planner unchanged

boundaries.actual_resource: Explicit measured workforce/resource relation; original amount/unit/date/actor/denominator preserved; no inferred productivity or revenue.
boundaries.actual_allocation: Explicit resource action/use plus money relation. Pure R&D expense accounting row does not gain priority; mixed original personnel paragraph may retain expense text without a separate financial extractor.
boundaries.planned_resource: Source actor + bounded future/plan state + concrete resource action/object; operating_plan only, not actual stock or achieved capability.
boundaries.conditional_negative: Retain existing modality/condition/qualification; never label hypothetical/question/negated quantity as actual.
boundaries.boilerplate: Heading, AI keyword, stakeholder value and generic efficiency language alone remain description.
boundaries.legacy: New semantic use attaches to production 0.9 owner. Freeze legacy detector/replay; do not silently change 0.8 by expanding shared text fallback.
